sentences.en: We abandoned the project because of a lack of funds.
sentences.zh: 因为资金不足，我们放弃了这个项目。

sentences.en: We made a pact that we wouldn't abandon one another.
sentences.zh: 我们立下誓言，不会抛弃彼此。

sentences.en: He abandoned his family and went to live in Tahiti.
sentences.zh: 他抛下了家人，去了塔希提岛生活。

mnemonic: a（没）+bandon（权力）→不再有权力→抛弃
